priorityList: Use Adrenaline Rush and Roll the Bones immediately before the pull.
Build Combo Points with Ambush (if available) or Sinister Strike.
Use Killing Spree at 6+ CP (if talented).
Use Between the Eyes at 6+ CP.
Use Roll the Bones on cooldown unless you are already in Stage 2 or higher.
Use Keep It Rolling when you are in Stage 2 or higher (can hold for Stage 3 or 4 if next Roll the Bones is buffed by Loaded Dice).
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at low Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown as if it were a regular builder.
Cast Dispatch as your first finisher with 5+ Combo Points if Slice and Dice is not active.
Cast Between the Eyes on cooldown with 6+ Combo Points.
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher with 5+ Combo Points.
Cast Pistol Shot if you have 6 stacks of Opportunity; use at 1-3 Combo Points if you have 3 stacks.
Cast Sinister Strike to generate Combo Points.
Cast Roll the Bones on cooldown if at stage 1 or less.
Cast Keep It Rolling if you have a stage 2 or higher Roll the Bones active.
Cast Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points.
Cast Between the Eyes on cooldown.
